hero.label: Custom Branding
hero.title: Launch Your Private Label Moroccan Black Soap Brand
hero.description: At Moroccan Black Soap, we provide authentic Beldi soap for businesses seeking to create a private label skincare or spa brand.
hero.p2: Moroccan black soap, known for its natural exfoliating, hydrating, and detoxifying properties, is ideal for cosmetic lines, hammam treatments, and luxury skincare products. This solution enables startups, salons, retailers, and cosmetic brands to launch a Moroccan black soap product line without investing in manufacturing facilities.
advantages: Access bulk supply with flexible MOQ
hero.badgeDesc: Start with flexible low MOQ orders

why.label: Value Proposition
why.title: Why Choose It for Private Label
why.desc: Beldi soap is globally recognized for its effectiveness and cultural heritage. By private labeling it, your brand can leverage a product with deep storytelling potential and clean positioning.
why.p2: Using Moroccan black soap in your product line enhances brand value, appeals to eco-conscious consumers, and allows authentic storytelling about heritage and natural skincare.

steps.title: Choose Your Product
steps.text: Select pure Beldi soap or request a custom formulation with natural additives like Argan oil, essential oils, or herbs.

steps.title: Design Your Brand
steps.text: Submit your logo, color palette, and label concept. Our design team can help create professional labels matching your brand.

steps.title: Approve Samples
steps.text: We send a sample of your custom-branded soap for approval. Adjustments to label, packaging, or formula can be made.

steps.title: Production & Shipping
steps.text: Once approved, we produce your order, quality-check each batch, and prepare export-ready shipments with full certificates.
